== dev_drive (Criar Dev Drive)
[INFO] Criando o Dev Drive D:\ (VHDX dinâmico de até 150 GB em C:\DevDrive\DevDrive.vhdx)...
[INFO] [dry-run] powershell: $vhd = 'C:\DevDrive\DevDrive.vhdx'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $vhd) | Out-Null; $roteiro = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('devdrive-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.txt'); Set-Content -Path $roteiro -Encoding ASCII -Value ('create vdisk file="' + $vhd + '" maximum=153600 type=expandable'); try {; diskpart /s $roteiro; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "diskpart terminou com código $LASTEXITCODE" }; } finally {; Remove-Item $roteiro -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; }; $disco = Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath $vhd -NoDriveLetter -PassThru | Get-Disk; Initialize-Disk -Number $disco.Number -PartitionStyle GPT; New-Partition -DiskNumber $disco.Number -UseMaximumSize -DriveLetter D | Out-Null; Format-Volume -DriveLetter D -DevDrive -NewFileSystemLabel 'DevDrive' -Confirm:$false -Force | Out-Null
[INFO] [dry-run] powershell: $acao = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "if (-not (Get-DiskImage -ImagePath ''C:\DevDrive\DevDrive.vhdx'').Attached) { Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath ''C:\DevDrive\DevDrive.vhdx'' }"'; $gatilho = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup; $quem = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'PostWindows-DevDrive' -Action $acao -Trigger $gatilho -Principal $quem -Description 'Monta o Dev Drive (post-windows)' -Force | Out-Null
